media_files_owner_chk.name: media_files_owner_chk
media_files_owner_chk.value: "media_files"."uploaded_by" IS NOT NULL OR "media_files"."uploaded_by_student_id" IS NOT NULL

assignments_owner_chk.name: assignments_owner_chk
assignments_owner_chk.value: "assignments"."teaching_assignment_id" IS NOT NULL OR "assignments"."owner_student_id" IS NOT NULL

evaluations_complete_chk.name: evaluations_complete_chk
evaluations_complete_chk.value:
"evaluations"."requires_redo"
        OR ("evaluations"."scheme" = 'score_10' AND "evaluations"."score" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("evaluations"."scheme" <> 'score_10' AND "evaluations"."level" IS NOT NULL)

notifications_recipient_chk.name: notifications_recipient_chk
notifications_recipient_chk.value: "notifications"."recipient_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "notifications"."recipient_student_id" IS NOT NULL

scan_jobs_requester_chk.name: scan_jobs_requester_chk
scan_jobs_requester_chk.value: "scan_jobs"."requested_by" IS NOT NULL OR "scan_jobs"."requested_by_student" IS NOT NULL
